summary: Gulf County, FL tower run by the Florida Forestry Service; a 1988 newspaper item describes a lookout at it; toppled by Hurricane Michael in 2018. No source describes the site today.

events.note: June 1988 News-Herald item, reprinted by Forest Lookouts, describes Verna Marshall working as lookout at the tower
The lookout reported the size and location of a fire in its early stages to district headquarters
Registered November 16, 2018; nominated by Brian Powell

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The brief's source starfl.com/news/20181108/toppled-by-michael returns HTTP 404 from the cache, so that article is unread. The register page links to 'Toppled by Michael - Photos' (target not read). Two web searches found no other coverage of this tower. No build date, design or height appears in any source read, so none is recorded. The 1988 item is reproduced on the Forest Lookouts site and attributed there to the Panama City News-Herald; the original newspaper was not checked. The 1988 'staffed' and 'fire' events rest on that one reprint. The brief's elevation (3 m) matches the register's 10 ft (3 m) and is an elevation, not a tower height.
